AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

DeadlineExceeded(address,address,uint256.details: Thrown when trying to fulfill a request after its deadline has passed.

InsufficientAllowance(uint256,uint256).details: Thrown when the contract does not have enough share allowance from the caller.

InsufficientShares(uint256,uint256).details: Thrown when the caller does not hold enough vault shares to cover the request.

IntentAssetsAboveMax(uint256,uint256).details: Thrown when the request's asset value exceeds the vault's configured maximum.

IntentAssetsBelowMin(uint256,uint256).details: Thrown when the request's asset value is below the vault's configured minimum.

InvalidAdminAddress().details: Thrown when the admin address is the zero address.

InvalidDeadline(uint256,uint256).details: Thrown when the deadline exceeds block.timestamp + maxDeadlineDuration.

InvalidIntentAmountBounds(uint256,uint25.details: Thrown when min intent assets is not less than max intent assets.

InvalidMaxDeadlineDuration().details: Thrown when the max deadline offset is set to zero.

InvalidRecipientAddress().details: Thrown when the recipient address is the zero address.

InvalidRelayerAddress().details: Thrown when the relayer address is the zero address.

InvalidVaultAddress().details: Thrown when the vault address is the zero address.

RequestNotFound(address,address).details: Thrown when no pending request exists for the given account and vault.

VaultNotWhitelisted().details: Thrown when the vault is not whitelisted.

MaxDeadlineDurationUpdated(uint256).details: Emitted when the admin updates the maximum allowed deadline offset.

params.maxDeadlineDuration: New maximum deadline offset in seconds.

RequestCancelled(address,address,uint256.details: Emitted when a user cancels their pending withdrawal request.

params.account: Address of the user who created the request.
params.vault: Address of the vault the request was against.

RequestCreated(address,address,uint256,u.details: Emitted when a user creates a new withdrawal request.

params.account: Address of the user creating the request.
params.deadline: Timestamp after which the request expires.
params.recipient: Address that will receive the redeemed assets.
params.shares: Number of vault shares to withdraw.
params.vault: Address of the vault to withdraw from.

RequestFulfilled(address,address,uint256.details: Emitted when the relayer fulfills a pending withdrawal request.

params.account: Address of the user whose request was fulfilled.
params.vault: Address of the vault the request was against.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

VaultConfigUpdated(address,bool,uint256,.details: Emitted when the admin updates a vault's configuration.

params.maxIntentAssets: New maximum asset value per request.
params.minIntentAssets: New minimum asset value per request.
params.vault: Address of the vault being configured.
params.whitelisted: Whether the vault is now whitelisted.

cancel(address).details: Cancels the caller's pending withdrawal request for a given vault.

params.vault: Address of the vault to cancel the request for.

fulfill(address,address,uint256).details: Fulfills a pending withdrawal request by redeeming shares from the vault.         This function can only called by accounts with RELAYER role.

params.account: Address of the user whose request is being fulfilled.
params.requestId: Expected request identifier, used to prevent stale fulfillments.
params.vault: Address of the vault to redeem from.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getRoleMember(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns one of the accounts that have `role`. `index` must be a value between 0 and {getRoleMemberCount}, non-inclusive. Role bearers are not sorted in any particular way, and their ordering may change at any point. WARNING: When using {getRoleMember} and {getRoleMemberCount}, make sure you perform all queries on the same block. See the following https://forum.openzeppelin.com/t/iterating-over-elements-on-enumerableset-in-openzeppelin-contracts/2296[forum post] for more information.

getRoleMemberCount(bytes32).details: Returns the number of accounts that have `role`. Can be used together with {getRoleMember} to enumerate all bearers of a role.

getRoleMembers(bytes32).details: Return all accounts that have `role` WARNING: This operation will copy the entire storage to memory, which can be quite expensive. This is designed to mostly be used by view accessors that are queried without any gas fees. Developers should keep in mind that this function has an unbounded cost, and using it as part of a state-changing function may render the function uncallable if the set grows to a point where copying to memory consumes too much gas to fit in a block.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

request(address,uint256,address,uint256).details: Creates a new withdrawal request for a given vault.          The caller must have approved this contract to transfer their vault shares.

params.deadline: Timestamp after which the request expires. Must be strictly greater than                     the current block timestamp and must not exceed block.timestamp + maxDeadlineDuration.
params.recipient: Address that will receive the redeemed assets.
params.shares: Number of vault shares to withdraw.
params.vault: Address of the vault to withdraw from.

returns.requestId: Identifier assigned to the new request.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setMaxDeadlineDuration(uint256).details: Sets the max allowed deadline offset from block.timestamp at request time.         This function can only be called by accounts with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

params.maxDeadlineDuration_: New maximum deadline offset in seconds.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

updateVaultConfig(address,bool,uint256,u.details: Updates the configuration for a given vault.         This function can only called by accounts with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

params.maxIntentAssets_: Maximum asset value allowed per request.
params.minIntentAssets_: Minimum asset value required per request.
params.vault: Address of the vault to configure.
params.whitelisted_: Whether the vault should be whitelisted.

RELAYER.details: Returns the ACL role identifier used for the relayer.
RELAYER.return: The bytes32 role hash for the relayer.

returns._0: The bytes32 role hash for the relayer.

maxDeadlineDuration.details: Returns the max time after a request is made that the deadline can be set to.
maxDeadlineDuration.return: Maximum deadline offset from block.timestamp at request time, in seconds.

returns._0: Maximum deadline offset from block.timestamp at request time, in seconds.

vaultConfig.details: Returns the configuration for a given vault.

params.vault: Address of the vault to query.

returns.maxIntentAssets: Maximum asset value allowed per request.
returns.minIntentAssets: Minimum asset value required per request.

vaultRequestCount.details: Returns the total number of withdrawal requests created for a given vault.

params.vault: Address of the vault to query.

vaultRequestCount.return: requestCount Total number of requests created. The last created request ID equals                       requestCount. The next request ID will be requestCount + 1.

returns.requestCount: Total number of requests created. The last created request ID equals                       requestCount. The next request ID will be requestCount + 1.

withdrawRequests.details: Returns the pending withdrawal request for a given account and vault.

params.account: Address of the user to query.
params.vault: Address of the vault to query.

returns.deadline: Timestamp after which the request expires.
returns.recipient: Address that will receive the redeemed assets.
returns.shares: Number of vault shares in the request.
